arguments.rule_content:
title: Detect Nmap SYN Scan
logsource:
  product: network
  service: firewall
 detection:
  selection:
    event_id: 2001
    destination_port: "*"
    protocol: tcp
    flags: SYN
  condition: selection and not src_ip in ("10.0.0.0/8", "192.168.0.0/16")
level: high
description: "Detects potential Nmap SYN scan from external IPs targeting internal network."
